package.name: mapping_utils
package.description:
Converts the B2's RoboSense (rslidar_sdk) XYZIRT PointCloud2 on /rslidar_points into the Velodyne XYZIRT layout consumed by FAST-LIO2 / FAST-LIVO2, published on /converted_rslidar_points: float32 `time` relative to the scan start, uint16 `ring`, float32 `intensity`, NaN points removed, and header.stamp rewritten from the RoboSense scan-END convention to the scan-START convention both mappers assume. Derived from the ROS 2 port of HViktorTsoi/rs_to_velodyne.
Also carries map_downsampler_node, which voxel-downsamples FAST-LIO's accumulated /Laser_map (pcl::PointXYZINormal, 48 B/pt) onto /downsampled_fastlio_map (pcl::PointXYZI, 32 B/pt) so a live coverage view can be streamed to Lichtblick over rosbridge, which the raw topic is far too large for. Its ~/load_pcd service does the same to a saved .pcd, onto /downsampled_pcd_map, giving 3D context during navigation.
And map_flattener_node, which turns one of those saved .pcd files into the 2D nav_msgs/OccupancyGrid nav2 needs: a z-band pass-through plus radius outlier removal, rasterised onto /flattened_map. The .pcd is chosen at runtime over ~/load_pcd and the filter thresholds are live-tunable from the UI, so both outputs are transient_local and published only on load and on change, with a per-rebuild JSON summary on /flattened_map_info. Derived from LihanChen2004/pcd2pgm.
And mapping_manager_node (Python), which owns a mapping session end to end: it starts and stops tmms_master's fast_lio.launch.py on request, names the output .pcd, saves it via /map_save on stop, and latches the static odom -> camera_init that anchors FAST-LIO's world frame to the robot's odometry. It owns the pcd/ half of the map store only -- the 2D .png + .yaml are written by the UI's map editor, since a flattened lidar map needs hand cleanup before it is fit to navigate on.
